qualifies: Not currently represented and no prior attorney on this matter
By an Uber or Lyft driver
Client can provide the ride receipt from the app (receipt emailed by Uber/Lyft and forwarded; phone screenshots not accepted)
Reported to at least one of: rideshare company, police, therapist/medical, friend or family member
Willing and able to provide corroborating statements, screenshots and communications to the attorneys
Incident did not occur in, and is not under the jurisdiction of, California, Colorado or Texas (firm instruction 2026-11-03)
disqualifies: Currently represented or had a prior attorney
Driver was not Uber or Lyft
Cannot provide the app ride receipt
Sex offender or felony conviction (asked by the firm, not on the public page)
Incident in or under the jurisdiction of California, Colorado or Texas
firm_only_screens: Abuse category: billable (vaginal/anal rape, oral rape, digital penetration) vs 5% JV backend (masturbation/forced genital touching, under- or over-clothes groping, forced kissing) — firm intake classifies; never shown or promised on the page
If reported to friend/family: name, relationship, may attorneys contact, willing to share their number
Legal authority if minor or incapacitated adult
criteria.commercial_terms_not_criteria: IO draft: 10 signed-retainer test at $1.6k CPA net-21 post-pay; 21-day replacement; refund policy; JV 5% backend. Not accepted; not a page claim.
